# Feature Request

Use this template to explain a feature or change you would like to see in TERMINALCASINO. Try to give enough information for us to understand what you are suggesting.

## What are you suggesting?

Explain the feature or change you would like added.

## Why should it be added?

Tell us why you think this would be useful or what it would improve about the project.

## What part of the project does it affect?

Does your idea involve a certain game, a new game, the menus, the terminal interface, or something else? If it is for a certain game, tell us which one.

## How would it work?

Explain how you think the feature should work from the player's point of view. What would the player do and what would happen after?

## What would the player see?

Since TERMINALCASINO is played through the terminal, describe what the player would see when using your feature. You can include an example of a menu, message, choices, or anything else that would appear in the terminal.

## Example

Give an example of how someone might use the feature if you have one.

## Other ideas

If you thought about another way this could work, you can explain it here.

## Anything else?

Add anything else that would help explain your idea. You can include screenshots, links, drawings, or examples from somewhere else.
